prompt: An original instrumental cinematic ambient soundtrack for a philosophical science exploration video game. Spacious arrangement, gradual harmonic evolution and restrained emotional development. Create profound wonder, discovery and cosmic scale without becoming dramatic or overwhelming. No vocals, no lyrics, no heavy percussion, no dramatic trailer crescendos, no aggressive electronic sounds, no sudden transitions. Create a complete instrumental composition of approximately four minutes.
